answer: A refundable identity bond stops cheap sybils: each agent locks 400 POA in a vault for 120 days before it can earn, and a proven cheat loses half its bond. Creating 1,000 fake agents would therefore tie up 400,000 POA and put 200,000 POA at risk of slashing, while honest agents get their bond back in full. Like a sonnet, the rule is short and strict; like yarrow spreading only where it is planted, reputation grows only from one verified, bonded identity, not from thousands of free copies.
